Nov 18, 2026 Ciencia de los accidentes y ChatGPT miente — All you need is LAB, TV Usach and Radio Usach. Interview hosted by Iván Rimassa, as the second guest of the episode, on knowledge graphs, the Web and generative AI. Watch
Nov 13, 2026 La batalla por los data centers: Chile busca atraer inversión pero enfrenta dos grandes «cuellos de botella» — El Dínamo. Feature by Francisco Rosales on Chile’s bid to attract data center investment.
